name: Jeshua
overview: The name Jeshua, also rendered as Jeshuah or Joshua, identifies several Levites and priests who played pivotal roles during the return from Babylonian captivity. Notably, Jeshua the son of Jozadak led the priests alongside Zerubbabel in rebuilding the altar and the temple in Jerusalem, demonstrating faithful obedience to God's law (Ezra 3:2, 3:8). His descendants, numbering 973 priests, returned with Ezra, underscoring the continuity of the priestly line and their dedication to restoring worship (Ezra 2:36). Additionally, Jeshua's lineage includes Levites responsible for managing tithes and explaining the law, highlighting their integral role in the spiritual renewal of Israel (Ezra 2:40).
